decision: No runtime replacement selected; retained-AST regression unresolved. Keep original POC implementation and correct benchmark warmup.

method.series: Serial fresh-process children; rotate variant order in each series. All completed samples retained. Do not pool absolute timings between series.
method.warmup: Two evenly spaced warmup passes. Matching warmup retains results only for retain mode; release warmup owners before premeasurement forced GC. Discard reproduces historical warmup.
method.finalControl: Five repetitions. Alternate policy order by repetition, and reverse baseline/poc order on even repetitions.
limitations: Interactive host with background activity. Initial profiling/screening overlapped unrelated tests. Extreme screening outliers retained.
Absolute rates visibly changed during literal confirmation; cause not established.
Instrumented trace/profile elapsed times are not throughput estimates. GC sums exclude uncollected tail and native allocations.
Comparison of medians is descriptive, not a confidence interval or statistical guarantee.

variantNames.prior: Original POC from ce917 with local imports and wrapResult export
variantNames.poc: Actual public eager.js at measurement time: original POC in retention-final, inline data properties in data-confirm/no-pretenure, literal getters in literal-confirm
variantNames.stamped: Private fields stamped onto shared-getter own properties
variantNames.literal: Private fields stamped onto literal own getters
variantNames.reset: Construct normal private instance, reset prototype to Object.prototype

construction.method: Preallocate 32267 tiny payloads, two 257-result warmups, force GC before timing; retain wrappers during timing, assert identity outside timing. Natural GC may be included. Not a complete parsing workload.

followupValidation.fullSuiteReuse: Original 178470 NAPI tests and parser conformance reused: runtime source, native binding, generated deserializers and printer restored unchanged. Trials each passed 13 focused tests with descriptor differences explicit.
